_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a few shapes in one simple figure, or a grid of squares; 2: a grid of rectangles or parallelograms counted by pairs of lines, or semicircles in plain circles; 3: triangles with a line across, overlapping squares, or a figure to pick from four; 4: triangles of several sizes pointing up and down, figures with many parts, or two counts at once. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
